about: Settings' Software Update (docs/adr/0030-installing-applications.mdx, decision 16) on a real oxyos-installd: the OS's row says this development install updates with apt (never a fake OS update); Inbox 1 is installed and the store publishes 2; Check for Updates reads the store once and lists Inbox 2 with its size (only what the machine lacks); Update All switches it: the apps are up to date, Inbox's row staying where it was, its control saying it updated (as the App Store keeps Updated Recently), Update All gone.
